title: Origin story: Stormscribe
description: Stormscribe was a lighthouse keeper's son who wrote down every storm — its hour, its temper, its damage — in ledgers that became the coast's law. When the great hurricane came, he climbed the lighthouse and wrote through it, and the storm, flattered by such attention, spared the town. He writes the weather still.

description: Ranked abilities: Weather-reading — rank 100/100; Chronicling — rank 97/100; Prediction — rank 96/100; Courage — rank 94/100; Endurance — rank 93/100.

title: Stamina feats: Stormscribe
